evidence: The reference omits selected-line indentation when the selection is wholly inside one logical line. Public ui.md:7 requires 'Tab and Shift+Tab should indent and outdent selected lines as one undoable action'. In the frozen task/solution/app/src/custom-editor.js:314 the Tab dispatch calls indentSelectedLines only when selectionRange().start.line !== selectionRange().end.line; :316 otherwise calls insertText('  '), which replaces the selected source. Authorized isolated browser probe (docker exec -i cw-editor-browser node -, URL http://172.17.0.10:3000/, no Save) selected the complete single line 'const value = 1;' using Home, Shift+End, then Tab. The observed source became '  ' rather than '  const value = 1;'. Undo restored the source. Positive controls: multi-line selected 'alpha\nbeta' became '  alpha\n  beta', Undo restored it, and a single-line Shift+Tab correctly outdented. No page errors. Raw artifact qc/runs/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r3/evidence/row17-single-line-indent-browser.log SHA256 49943668e69fedab24bd3fda271a7f05d66a69a9057a96de1bae7a8269499635. The served /app/public/assets/index-B33FNNrg.js SHA256 7fa3bf61b9f2301d40ce368f513a05ae089a69d6e2555b9666588120a50b5b8c exactly matches the frozen bundle. Other requested screens/flows are plausible in app.tsx:109-155, custom-editor.js, runtime.ts and server.js. Hash-verified existing browser and persistence logs cover typing/navigation/graphemes, long lines, selection/multi-carets, find/replace, JS/HTML formatting, execution and isolation, last-good recovery/cancellation, stale save/restore, idempotent restore and process-restart history. Their respective SHA256 values are 922614fd042f8f17f4de8e12a61247b6414a1455ae281ebd1a199cb146465eac and fb7e152f599e21e6bf1eab377e0a78249f25f0b9edf8e4d26e789e6b53088a0f. This is product behavior evidence; no configured judge, Oracle, model or portal score is asserted.
counterexample: A reference/weak implementation that handles only multi-line block indentation can pass the existing block-indent probes while deleting a selected single-line experiment on Tab. A conforming implementation must preserve that selected line's source and indent it as one undoable change; its layout, labels and routes may differ because policy.md:3 permits those alternatives. No alternative implementation constraint is needed to demonstrate this failure.
suggested_fix: Route every non-collapsed selection, including a selection wholly inside one logical line, through indentSelectedLines for Tab/Shift+Tab; rebuild the static bundle and verify source preservation plus one-action Undo/Redo.
